sentences.text: Bhuri vs State Of U.P. on 18 May, 2023

Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:108253
Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 22292 of 2023
Applicant :- Bhuri

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Garun Pal Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Learned counsel for the applicant prays for and is permitted to make necessary correction in the jail period of the applicant during course of the day.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 73 of 2023, registered under Sections 120-B, 195, 363, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Kosikalan, District Mathura during pendency of the trial.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.

Applicant lodged FIR against the named Bhuri vs State Of U.P. on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135596204/
1 accused persons under Sections 376-D, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.

Statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. of the victim and informant supported the prosecution case but Investigating Officer on the statement of informer, arrested the applicant and implicated in the present case.
Investigating Officer had to proceed against the named accused persons but informant has been made accused in the present case.
Applicant has no previous criminal history.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 29.03.2023.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Bhuri, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 18.5.2023 Nitin Verma  Bhuri vs State Of U.P. on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135596204/
